scope:
Price actual compiled Part/color phases and count their memory traffic.

The changed production fragments, full Part layout and scalar loops execute as
SH4 instructions. Observed color edges check every live ARGB word. The unchanged
directional/exact light calculation supplies synthetic ARGB words outside the
timed instruction trace. Position writes, cache priming and TA submission are
excluded; therefore removed color visits do not imply fewer total vertex-cache
lines in the renderer. Warm/cold-I cycle estimates use perfect D-cache and a
synthetic code layout, not hardware time or a captured character workload.
The Part observer keeps full construction live, including stores a production
caller may omit. Per-Part and per-meshlet deltas are isolated phase estimates.
build_scope:
Build SH4 Part-construction + color-phase probes from production fragments.

Part, Frame, Lights, Records and flat_colors are the complete real definitions.
Part alpha/retained-color setup and both color/post-half loops are copied from
the source verbatim. Three unchanged directional/exact lighting calls become
explicit observed return edges. Position, selection, emit and optional Leon
debug-toggle phases are excluded. Complete production objects are independent.
The external Part observer deliberately keeps the entire constructor live and
can retain stores that production callers eliminate. These are isolated phase
prices with synthetic register allocation/alias boundaries, not call-site cost.

controls: data read of current opcode word retained
double-register move counted as one 8-byte load
store queues excluded from cached footprint
cached PREF counted separately from demand loads

opcode_controls.scope: XOR immediate decodes unsigned8-bit operand and preserves T; no memory access
